items.title: Forget electrons, this breakthrough uses light-matter particles to power AI
items.summary: Researchers at Penn have created a hybrid light-matter particle that could dramatically speed up AI computing while using far less energy. The breakthrough may help replace some electronic computing processes with ultra-efficient light-based technology.
